name: const unsafe fn read < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: If `src` results from casting a reference to a pointer, it is guaranteed valid for reads while the underlying object remains live and no reference is used to access the same memory; reference accesses and raw-pointer accesses must not be interleaved during that scope.
api: const unsafe fn read < T > (src : * const T) -> T
